function: Learned ST-GNN only detects falls from RSS (sensing application); key generation is non-learned; no beams, waveforms or resources are designed; none of the seven areas (pp. 6-8, 14).
notes: Excluded as function. The only learned component is the ST-GNN, whose output is a fall or no-fall decision (p. 7: "Fall detection output layer is a binary classifier"; p. 14: "a machine learning-based ST-GNN method for fall detection"). The communication side, key generation, is not learned (p. 4: "We propose a time-series-peak-pattern approach for key generation between two users"; p. 5: "we propose a simple bitwise mismatch zeroing method"). No beams, waveforms or resources are designed, so area 5 does not apply, and there is no MIMO or RIS processing, only an RFID reader with two antennas (p. 8). A reviewer who reads fall detection as an application rather than a physical-layer function could prefer no_learning.
